snippet.title: Surreality Check Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game on steam today : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2758010/Surreality_Check/

Something is wrong. You don’t know what. You need help.

Surreality Check is a narrative-focused visual novel with 3D exploration where you play as anxiety riddled cockroach extraordinaire: Rowan Roach as you try to help him feel okay with himself. To this end, you delve into a dimension of his deepest self to have therapy sessions with the Universe personified.
